response.rationale: Both Malay forms correctly express the calendar year immediately after the current year. Indonesian tahun depan is ordinary; Malaysian tahun hadapan is standard, while tahun depan also occurs in Malaysian usage. The relation is appropriately lexical variation without a false-friend contrast.
